items.item_text: Event-planning or event-production experience in higher education, hospitality, conference services, a nonprofit organization, or another complex service environment. Experience using an Event Management System or comparable event-scheduling or venue-management platform; experience with EMS, Pomona College’s current system, is strongly preferred. Experience with Cvent, Salesforce, Formstack, website content-management systems, or comparable platforms. Experience coordinating work across multiple departments, vendors, and service providers. Experience with campus scheduling, space reservations, and event-service workflows.
· Provide hands-on planning, production, administrative, and logistical support across multiple event portfolios.
· Independently plan, coordinate, and oversee assigned events or projects from initial consultation through execution and follow-up.
· Develop and maintain event timelines, task lists, staffing plans, production schedules, briefing materials, budgets, and follow-up documentation.

· Coordinate event requirements involving campus venues, furnishings and equipment, catering, audiovisual services, vendors, rentals, work orders, staffing, signage, accessibility, and onsite implementation.

· Serve as a responsive, service-oriented point of contact for assigned events and work effectively with faculty, staff, administrators, students, vendors, guest speakers, artists, and campus partners.
· Coordinate across campus departments and service providers, monitor progress, identify potential conflicts, and elevate issues requiring additional direction.
· Enter, review, and maintain accurate event and reservation information in the College’s Event Management System, EMS.
· Support event communications and registration processes, which may include invitations, reservation forms, guest lists, name tags, attendance materials, and event-related correspondence.
· Provide onsite event support, including setup oversight, vendor coordination, client or guest support, and breakdown, as assigned.
· Collect and process event-related invoices, support contract and vendor documentation, and maintain accurate event records.
· Perform other duties and event-related projects as assigned.
